column1: # S3 classification -- every line in gate_logs/coverage/uncovered_by_file.txt must match
# exactly one rule here. Format:  CATEGORY <TAB> path-suffix <TAB> lines <TAB> evidence
#   B-FLIGHT   not reachable by ctest, but PROVEN by a named flight gate. Evidence must
#              name the gate. This is the project's architecture, not an excuse: logic
#              lives in ROS-free libs (unit-tested), the node layer is the wiring, and
#              wiring is proven by flying it.
#   B-ENTRY    process entry point (rclcpp init/spin/shutdown). Runs in every launch.
#   B-DIAG     enum-to-string tables, default: arms, log-only lines. A wrong string
#   A-TESTED   safety-relevant, and a test was written for it in this pass.
#   D-BOUNDARY cannot be covered in simulation at all. Must cite a B-nn boundary entry
#              and carries a signature line in docs/coverage-classification.md.
# "lines" is *  for the whole file, or a-b range, comma separated.
# --- B-ENTRY: process entry points. Every launch-based gate runs these.
